lines.en: label mikuspring6:
scene sky
Lately, I’ve been feeling like pretty much the whole world is against me. Which is kind of par for the course after the world finds out you’re dating a celebrity, I guess.
lines.zh: 最近，我总觉得几乎全世界都在跟我作对。不过在全世界都知道你在跟一个名人交往之后，这大概也算意料之中吧。

lines.en: And while this is not the life I would have chosen for myself, I do think it’s funny that I didn’t even need to work for it the way Niki did and I’m sure that probably bothers her.
lines.zh: 虽然这绝不是我为自己选择的人生，但我确实觉得挺好笑的：我根本不用像 Niki 那样为之打拼就得到了这一切，而我敢肯定这一点大概很让她不爽。

lines.en: But I’m also pretty sure she would say something about me not being an {i}actual{/i} celebrity since I’m just stitched to her coattails or something like that but, in a sense, she’s stitched to mine as well.
lines.zh: 不过我也挺确定，她会说我不算{i}真正的{/i}名人，因为我不过是缝在她的衣摆上之类的——但从某种意义上说，她也缝在我的衣摆上。

lines.en: So the two of us at this point are essentially just a toxic and immobile quilt. And that sucks. But there are bright sides, surely. Because there’s no way {i}everyone{/i} keeps up with pop culture, right?
lines.zh: 所以到这一步，我们俩基本上就是一床有毒又挪不动的被子。这挺糟的。但总该有好的一面吧。因为不可能{i}所有人{/i}都在关注流行文化，对吧？

lines.en: For example — I’m calling Miku right now since she seems mildly detached from all of that stuff when compared to everyone else.
lines.zh: 比如说——我现在就在给 Miku 打电话，因为跟其他人比起来，她似乎对这些东西稍微没那么上心。

lines.en: : {i}Yo! How’s my favorite idol-bangin’ teacher?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哟！我最爱的那个睡偶像的老师最近怎么样？{/i}

lines.en: But apparently not detached enough. So there goes whatever I was about to say, I guess.
lines.zh: 但显然还不够不上心。那我本来准备说的那些话，看来也就算了。

lines.en: : I’m afraid to leave my house. People keep taking pictures of me.
lines.zh: : 我都不敢出门了。一直有人拍我。

lines.en: : {i}Your pants zipped up? No big floppy wiener hangin’ out and enticin’ all the soccer moms?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}裤子拉链拉好了没？没有软趴趴的大鸡巴晃在外面勾引那些足球妈妈吧？{/i}

lines.en: : Yes, Miku. My pants are zipped up.
lines.zh: : 拉好了，Miku。我的裤子拉链是拉上的。

lines.en: : {i}Yeah, probably just the idol thing then.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那大概就是偶像那档子事了。{/i}

lines.en: : You don’t say.
lines.zh: : 这还用你说。

lines.en: : {i}The heck you callin’ me for? Shouldn’t you be stickin’ it in Noriko’s sister’s mouth or somethin’? Ain’t no way I can compare to her.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你打给我到底干啥？你不该把那玩意儿塞进 Noriko 姐姐的嘴里什么的吗？我可比不上她。{/i}

lines.en: : You’re actually pretty good at blowjobs, Miku. It’s a quality I didn’t expect, but I very much appreciate.
lines.zh: : 你口交其实挺厉害的，Miku。这是我没料到的优点，但我非常欣赏。

lines.en: : {i}Thanks! Gotta prove my worth somehow since my vagina is broken.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}谢谢！反正我的小穴是坏的，总得想办法证明点价值吧。{/i}

lines.en: : I think it’s fixed by now, Miku. And I also think that you should stop whatever you’re doing to come hang out with me.
lines.zh: : 我觉得它现在应该已经修好了，Miku。而且我还觉得，你应该放下手头的事过来陪陪我。

lines.en: : {i}What? Uhh...but didn’t you just say all that stuff about people takin’ pictures of you?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哈？呃……可你刚刚不是才说了一堆有人拍你之类的话吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Cause I ain’t exactly on the best terms with Maki right now and the last thing I need is proof that you’re the one porkin’ or...at least trying to pork me.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}因为我现在跟 Maki 的关系可不怎么样，我最不需要的就是留下证据，证明干我的人——或者……至少试图干我的人——是你。{/i}

lines.en: : I’m not suggesting we go on some date outdoors or something. Just come over and hang out with me.
lines.zh: : 我又没说要我们出去约会什么的。就是过来陪我待会儿。

lines.en: : I’d like the company of someone less...{i}pink{/i} this time. Someone more uninformed and detached from the expectations of society.
lines.zh: : 这次我想要个没那么……{i}粉红{/i}的人陪着。一个更不了解世事、更远离社会期待的人。

lines.en: : {i}Society don’t care about how pink somebody is, Sensei. It’s all about just doin’ what everybody else is doin’ around here. And not everybody’s bagged Niki Nakayama.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}社会才不管一个人有多粉红呢，Sensei。重点就是跟着这儿其他人做一样的事。又不是谁都把 Niki Nakayama 泡到手了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}’Sides, your place ain’t exactly safe either. Like, how do I know Ami won’t snap a picture of me and use it for some sort of blackmail thingy? Or how do we know Niki won’t find you bangin’ me next?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}再说了，你家也不见得安全啊。比如，我怎么知道 Ami 不会拍我的照片拿去敲诈什么的？又怎么知道 Niki 不会接着就撞见你在干我？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Whole situation’s too hot, and not in the good way. So we should probably just wait until things start coolin’ down to actually hang out again.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}整个局面太烫手了，而且不是那种好的烫。所以咱们大概还是等事情降温了再真的出来玩吧。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Unless of course you’ve got some sort of top-secret rendezvous point or somethin’ where we could meet up away from the pryin’ eyes of the paparazzi.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}当然啦，除非你有什么绝密接头点之类的地方，能让咱们躲开狗仔的窥视见个面。{/i}

lines.en: : Yeah, about that. I do.
lines.zh: : 嗯，说到这个。我还真有。

lines.en: : {i}You know, I should probably be surprised, but I really ain’t. You’re a shady friggin’ guy, Sensei.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你知道吗，我大概该惊讶一下的，可我真的一点也不。你真是个可疑透顶的家伙，Sensei。{/i}

lines.en: : Hey, {i}you’re{/i} the one coming to meet up with me at a discreet location. That makes you just as bad as me.
lines.zh: : 嘿，{i}你{/i}才是那个跑来隐蔽地点跟我会面的人。这么说来你跟我一样坏。

lines.en: : {i}I don’t think it does, but sign me up! And no cameras, got it? Last thing I need right now is more heat. It’s gettin’ exhaustin’ havin’ to deal with the new Maki.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我可不这么认为，不过算我一份！而且不能有摄像头，明白吗？我现在最不需要的就是更多的麻烦。应付这个「新 Maki」已经够累人了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}New{/i} Maki?
lines.zh: : {i}新{/i} Maki？

lines.en: : {i}I’ll tell ya more about it when I get to your sex dungeon! Send me the address and I’ll drop by after school.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}等我到了你的性爱地牢再跟你细说！把地址发我，我放学后过去。{/i}

lines.en: : Oh, right. You’re in school.
lines.zh: : 啊，对。你还在上学。

lines.en: : {i}Yeah. You wanna say hi to Futaba? She’s been with me in the library this whole time.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是啊。要不要跟 Futaba 打个招呼？她一直在图书馆陪着我呢。{/i}

lines.en: : She’s been {i}listening?{/i}
lines.zh: : 她一直在{i}听？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Hi, Sensei...And don’t worry, I won’t say anything.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你好，Sensei……放心吧，我什么都不会说的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Futaba and I were just bondin’ over bein’ sexually active before you called. See what I said there? Futaba and I. We’re studying too.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你打来之前，我和 Futaba 正因为我们都有性生活这件事拉近关系呢。听出来了吗？我和 Futaba。我们也有在学习的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}That...is the main reason we are in the library. We did not come here to talk about sex.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那……才是我们来图书馆的主要原因。我们不是来聊性的。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Potato, tomato. Anyway, I’m startin’ to get stared at, so I’ll see ya later! Bye, Sensei! I mean...boyfriend from another school!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}土豆，番茄，差不多啦。总之，我开始被人盯着看了，回头见！拜拜，Sensei！我是说……外校的男朋友！{/i}

lines.en: : Bring Futaba as well and I can educate the two of you about threesomes.
lines.zh: : 把 Futaba 也带上，我可以给你们两个上上三人行的课。

lines.en: : {i}Pass! The more wiener I get for myself, the better. Bye!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}免了！鸡巴归我一个人用得越多越好。拜！{/i}

lines.en: : But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: scene black
Damn it.
lines.zh: 可恶。

lines.en: How did that not work?
lines.zh: 这怎么就没成功呢？

lines.en: scene mikusecretapt1
Miku arrives at my under-utilized secret apartment about an hour after school ends and it immediately dawns on me that I now have a use for this place again since my regular house is bugged.
lines.zh: 放学后大约一个小时，Miku 来到了我那间闲置的秘密公寓。我立刻意识到，既然我常住的房子被装了窃听器，这地方又派上用场了。

lines.en: And while I’m {i}pretty{/i} sure I managed to find most of Ami’s recording devices, I imagine there are more I just {i}haven’t{/i} found yet.
lines.zh: 虽然我{i}相当{/i}确定自己已经找出了 Ami 大部分的录音设备，但我想肯定还有{i}没{/i}找到的。

lines.en: Which means I must now put all of my faith in Touka and hope that she hasn’t actually bugged this place too.
lines.zh: 这意味着我现在只能把所有信任都押在 Touka 身上，希望她没有也把这地方给装上窃听器。

lines.en: : Hey! Sorry for not bringin’ Futaba. But if it makes ya feel any better, we ain’t really sure how a threesome’d work in the first place since we both like boys.
lines.zh: : 嘿！抱歉没带 Futaba 来。不过要是能让你好受点的话，我们俩压根就不知道三人行该怎么搞，因为我俩都喜欢男孩子。

lines.en: : Plus, havin’ those bazongas in my face’d probably make me freak out and bite your wiener off outta jealousy or somethin’.
lines.zh: : 再说，让那对大波在我面前晃，我大概会当场崩溃，出于嫉妒一口把你的鸡巴咬下来什么的。

lines.en: : If I wanted Ami here, I would have invited Ami.
lines.zh: : 如果我想让 Ami 在这儿，我就会邀请 Ami 了。

lines.en: scene mikusecretapt2
: Yeah, I guess if we’re really gonna do this with three people, havin’ somebody like her would be a lot better for my self-confidence.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我想如果我们真的要三个人一起做，有个像她那样的人在场，对我的自信心会好不少。

lines.en: : That’s not what- {i}hah.{/i} Okay. Hi. Welcome to my secret apartment.
lines.zh: : 我不是那个意思——{i}哈。{/i}好吧。你好，欢迎来到我的秘密公寓。

lines.en: : How the heck do you even afford this place? You don’t have a job.
lines.zh: : 你到底是怎么付得起这地方的？你又没有工作。

lines.en: : Touka gave it to me. And try to keep your voice down since Chika and Tsukasa also live here.
lines.zh: : 是 Touka 给我的。另外小声点，Chika 和 Tsukasa 也住在这儿。

lines.en: : Ain’t Tsukasa that little girl who hijacked the class for some bogus national holiday a while back? You porkin’ her too?
lines.zh: : Tsukasa 不就是前阵子为了某个假节日把全班都劫持了的那个小女孩吗？你把她也睡了？

lines.en: : No, Miku. I am not having sex with Touka’s little sister.
lines.zh: : 没有，Miku。我没有跟 Touka 的妹妹上床。

lines.en: : Hey, I never know with you. What’s the plan, though? I ain’t ever been a call-girl before. You payin’ me for this?
lines.zh: : 嘿，跟你有关的事我可说不准。不过计划是什么呢？我以前可没当过应召女郎。你要付我钱吗？

lines.en: : No, I just wanted to see you. I missed you.
lines.zh: : 不是，我只是想见你。我想你了。

lines.en: scene mikusecretapt3
: Y...You...huh?!
scene mikusecretapt4
: D...Don’t just say stuff like that outta the blue! I’m still a girl, ya know! Ya gotta hit me with a little emotional foreplay before you bust a load like that all over my face!
lines.zh: : 别……别突然就说这种话啊！我好歹也是个女孩子，你知道吗！你总得先来点情感前戏，再突然把那一发全射在我脸上吧！

lines.en: : I also don’t think I’ve mentioned that I like your new haircut yet either. You look really cute.
lines.zh: : 而且我觉得我还没说过我喜欢你的新发型。你看起来真的很可爱。

lines.en: scene mikusecretapt5
: That...I...uhh...
: Thank you...
lines.zh: : 谢谢你……

lines.en: : I wanted to keep growin’ it out since I heard ya like it that way, but...the thing happened again and Makoto had to...clean stuff up.
lines.zh: : 我本来想继续留长的，因为听说你喜欢那样，可是……那件事又发生了，Makoto 不得不……收拾一番。

lines.en: : Is everything okay? Did something happen?
lines.zh: : 一切都还好吗？出什么事了吗？

lines.en: : Not that I can remember...Just kinda happened one night. Whole thing still feels like a blur. So weird.
lines.zh: : 我记不太清了……就是有一天晚上突然发生的。整件事到现在都还模模糊糊的。好奇怪。

lines.en: scene mikusecretapt6
: You really like it? You ain’t just sayin’ that to make me feel better?
lines.zh: : 你真的喜欢吗？你不是为了让我好受点才这么说的吧？

lines.en: : Yes. It looks very soft and makes me want to reach forward and mess it up so you can look even more embarrassed.
lines.zh: : 是的。看起来很柔软，让我很想伸手把它弄乱，好让你看起来更害羞。

lines.en: scene mikusecretapt7
: I...I ain’t embarrassed! Just a little surprised and flattered and horny! What do you have in the fridge?!
lines.zh: : 我……我才没有害羞！只是有点意外、有点受宠若惊，还有点发情！你冰箱里有什么？！

lines.en: : Nice segue.
lines.zh: : 话题转得真自然。

lines.en: scene mikusecretapt8
: Fine! You leave me no choice but to go check myself!
lines.zh: : 好！你这是逼我自己去看！

lines.en: : Miku-
lines.zh: : Miku——

lines.en: scene mikusecretapt9
: No ifs, ands, or asses! We both know you’re a guy who strictly adheres to gender norms, which means I’m expected to make ya dinner if you didn’t call me over here to put it in my mouth!
lines.zh: : 少跟我扯什么「如果」「而且」「屁股」！我们都清楚你是个严守性别规范的家伙，也就是说，如果你叫我过来不是为了把那玩意儿塞进我嘴里，那我就该给你做晚饭！

lines.en: : Miku Maruyama can be a trad-wife too! You just watch, buddy!
lines.zh: : Miku Maruyama 也能当个传统好老婆！你走着瞧，老兄！

lines.en: : Miku, put the cooking equipment down. I don’t want this building going up in flames when children live here.
lines.zh: : Miku，把厨具放下。这栋楼里住着小孩，我可不想让它烧起来。

lines.en: scene mikusecretapt10
: Oh? You doubtin’ my abilities to cook, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 哦？你这是在怀疑我的厨艺吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : Yes. As a matter of fact, I am. Lets just order a pizza if you’re hungry.
lines.zh: : 是的。事实上，我就是在怀疑。你要是饿了我们就叫个披萨吧。

lines.en: : And if the pizza delivery girl is a rabid Niki fan who finds out about your secret apartment, then what? You willin’ to have that secret blown just cause you don’t believe in me?
lines.zh: : 那要是送披萨的女孩是个 Niki 的狂热粉丝，还发现了你的秘密公寓，那怎么办？你愿意就因为不相信我，把秘密给暴露了吗？

lines.en: : It’s not that I don’t believe in you. I just think you’re going to do a terrible job that could result in the deaths of many.
lines.zh: : 不是我不相信你。我只是觉得你会干得糟透了，搞不好会闹出人命。

lines.en: scene mikusecretapt11
: That sounds a lot like you not believin’ in me, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 这话听着很像你就是不相信我啊，Sensei。

lines.en: : Damn. I was hoping your listening comprehension hadn’t improved much either. You got me, though. All that studying is apparently paying off.
lines.zh: : 可恶。我还指望你的听力理解也没怎么进步呢。不过你说对了。看来那些学习确实有回报了。

lines.en: : Point is, I ain’t pretendin’ to be no Guy Fieri or anythin’, but I can cook some basic stuff. I just normally ain’t allowed to use fire at Makoto’s place, so I have to resort to other methods.
lines.zh: : 重点是，我又没装成什么 Guy Fieri 之类的，但一些基本的东西我还是会做的。只是在 Makoto 家我通常不准用火，所以只能另想办法。

lines.en: : So...you microwave things?
lines.zh: : 所以……你都是用微波炉？

lines.en: : Cookin’s still cookin’, ain’t it?
lines.zh: : 做饭不还是做饭吗，对吧？

lines.en: : I mean...you’re not {i}wrong-{/i}
lines.zh: : 我是说……你也{i}没说错——{/i}

lines.en: scene mikusecretapt10
: Then leave it to me.
lines.zh: : 那就交给我吧。

lines.en: : I’ll whip ya up a grade-A meal with whatever you’ve got in the fridge! Unless it’s some sorta body. I ain’t gonna endorse you breakin’ any laws, you hear me?
lines.zh: : 我用你冰箱里现有的东西，给你弄一顿甲级大餐！除非那是某种尸体。我可不会纵容你违法，听到了吗？

lines.en: : I mean...I {i}do.{/i} But-
lines.zh: : 我是说……我{i}确实有{/i}。不过——

lines.en: : Silence! The time for flavor has arrived!
lines.zh: : 安静！属于风味的时刻到来了！

lines.en: scene mikusecretapt12
: What kinda house only keeps bean sprouts stocked up?
lines.zh: : 什么人家冰箱里只囤豆芽啊？

lines.en: : You’d have to ask Touka. I don’t stay here long enough to warrant keeping any food here at all.
lines.zh: : 这你得问 Touka。我在这儿待的时间不长，根本没必要存任何吃的。

lines.en: scene mikusecretapt13
: Does she live here too? That her condition for lettin’ you have the place for free? Blink twice if you’ve become the rich girl’s slave.
lines.zh: : 她也住这儿吗？这就是她让你免费住这地方的条件？要是你成了富家女的奴隶就眨两下眼。

lines.en: : It’s not like that. She just hangs out here when she wants to...hang out here, I guess?
lines.zh: : 不是那样的。她就是想……在这儿待着的时候就在这儿待着吧，我猜？

lines.en: : You bone her yet? See her boobs up close? They as crazy as they look while she’s wearin’ clothes?
lines.zh: : 你睡她了吗？近距离看过她的奶子吗？是不是跟她穿着衣服时看起来一样夸张？

lines.en: : I have not {i}boned{/i} her. But she did jerk me off in an alley once.
lines.zh: : 我没有{i}睡{/i}她。不过她曾在巷子里给我撸过一次。

lines.en: : Nice. It’s always the classy ones who are into that kinky stuff.
lines.zh: : 不错。总是那些高雅的人喜欢这种变态玩意儿。

lines.en: scene mikusecretapt14
: You know, ignoring the fact that it’s just bean sprouts, this really doesn’t look that bad.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，撇开只有豆芽这一点不谈，这看起来还真不赖。

lines.en: : Hard to mess up bean sprouts. Sorry that’s all I could do for ya.
lines.zh: : 豆芽很难做坏的。抱歉我只能为你做到这些了。

lines.en: : I’ve actually been practicin’ cooking a lot lately since nobody at the Miyamura’s place can do it and Maki ain’t really been in the mood to try.
lines.zh: : 其实我最近一直在练习做饭，因为 Miyamura 家没人会做，而 Maki 也一直没什么心情去试。

lines.en: scene mikusecretapt15
: Yeah, well...she {i}did{/i} basically find out I’ve been having sex with both of her daughters behind her back. That’s probably going to fuck her up for a little while.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那个……她{i}确实{/i}发现了我背着她跟她两个女儿上床。这大概够她难受一阵子的。

lines.en: : It’s kinda weird seein’ her so...uptight, I guess. Like, tryin’ to give us curfews and makin’ sure we don’t work too long at the shop anymore. Feels like she’d just fire us entirely if she didn’t need the help.
lines.zh: : 看她变得这么……紧绷，感觉挺怪的。比如，开始给我们定门禁，还盯着不许我们在店里干太久。感觉如果不是还需要人帮忙，她大概会直接把我们炒了。

lines.en: : I guess that’s what you meant by “new” Maki, then?
lines.zh: : 那大概就是你说的「新」Maki 吧？

lines.en: : She’s still Maki. But yeah...she’s been kinda different lately. Sad. Like she doesn’t really {i}get{/i} it, you know?
lines.zh: : 她还是 Maki。不过是啊……她最近有点不一样了。很消沉。感觉她其实并不{i}明白{/i}，你懂吗？

lines.en: : I mean...she {i}does{/i} get it. That’s the problem. She’s not like everyone else who will sit idly by while I fuck the entire city — teenagers included.
lines.zh: : 我是说……她{i}明白{/i}。问题就在这儿。她不像其他人那样，会袖手旁观我操遍整个城市——包括未成年人在内。

lines.en: : Yeah, but it’s like I said before. Society’s all about doin’ what everybody else is doin’. And if Maki’s the only person who’s got a problem with it, don’t that make her the {i}abnormal{/i} one?
lines.zh: : 是啊，可就像我之前说的。社会就是大家做什么你就做什么。如果只有 Maki 一个人对此有意见，那不就说明{i}不正常{/i}的是她吗？

lines.en: : There are other people with problems. You’re just not exposed to them as often as I am.
lines.zh: : 有意见的人不止她一个。只是你不像我这么经常碰到他们罢了。

lines.en: : But you literally {i}just{/i} said she’s not like everyone else who will sit idly by while you bang the entire city. Ain’t that a critical hippo?
lines.zh: : 可你{i}刚刚{/i}才说她不像其他人那样，会看着你操遍整个城市还袖手旁观。这难道不是个关键河马吗？

lines.en: scene mikusecretapt16
: Excuse me?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : Way I look at it’s kinda simple, Sensei. You might {i}look{/i} like an adult. You might have lived as long as an adult. Heck, you basically just {i}are{/i} an adult.
lines.zh: : 在我看来这事儿挺简单的，Sensei。你可能{i}看起来{/i}像个大人。你可能也活了跟大人一样久。说真的，你基本上就{i}是{/i}个大人。

lines.en: : I...{i}am{/i} an adult.
lines.zh: : 我……{i}就是{/i}个大人。

lines.en: : You’re kinda {i}not,{/i} though. Like, even when you were teaching, you always felt more like a friend my age than any of the other old people I’ve met.
lines.zh: : 可你又有点{i}不算{/i}。比如，就算你还在教书的时候，你给我的感觉也一直更像一个跟我同年纪的朋友，而不是我见过的那些老家伙。

lines.en: scene mikusecretapt17
: Probably why I like you so much. I ain’t ever felt that way about adults before. Or anybody, really. But you know what I mean, yeah.
lines.zh: : 大概这就是为什么我这么喜欢你。我以前从没对大人有过这种感觉。或者说，对任何人都没有过。不过你懂我的意思吧，对吧。

lines.en: : I do...And it shows that I’ve been...unintentionally successful as a coach in mental gymnastics since that’s exactly what any girl who has been groomed would likely say.
lines.zh: : 我懂……而这也说明，我作为心理体操教练意外地成功，因为任何一个被诱导过的女孩大概都会这么说。

lines.en: : Maybe you’ve just gotta teach Maki those same gymnastics then?
lines.zh: : 那也许你只要把同一套体操教给 Maki 就行了？

lines.en: : Like, I know I probably ain’t smart enough to figure out what’s right and wrong about all of this when it comes to actual morals or whatever.
lines.zh: : 比如，我知道自己大概没那么聪明，搞不明白这一切在真正的道德之类的事情上到底谁对谁错。

lines.en: : But I know that bein’ with you makes me happy. And I know that bein’ with me makes {i}you{/i} happy. And that if we can’t make each other happy because of a number...that’s kinda lame, ain’t it?
lines.zh: : 但我知道，跟你在一起让我很开心。我也知道，跟我在一起让{i}你{/i}很开心。如果我们只因为一个数字就不能让彼此开心……那也太逊了吧？

lines.en: : So many bean sprouts.
lines.zh: : 好多豆芽。

lines.en: scene mikusecretapt18
: You just dodgin’ questions now?
lines.zh: : 你现在是在回避问题吧？

lines.en: : Well, yeah. I don’t want to be complicit or {i}agree{/i} with any of what you’re saying because that sends the wrong message.
lines.zh: : 嗯，是啊。我不想成为同谋，也不想{i}赞同{/i}你说的任何一句，因为那会传递错误的信息。

lines.en: : What’s the right message then? Give it to me in a way some girl with a D- average could understand.
lines.zh: : 那什么才是正确的信息？用我这种平均成绩 D- 的女孩能听懂的方式讲给我听。

lines.en: : Some things are just black and white. This is one of them.
lines.zh: : 有些事就是非黑即白。这就是其中之一。

lines.en: : So the message is to just accept and deal with the rules we’re handed without questionin’ ‘em? And that Maki’s slump is actually a good thing because she’s goin’ by the book?
lines.zh: : 所以你的意思是，别人塞给我们的规则就得照单全收、别去质疑？Maki 的低谷其实是件好事，因为她在照章办事？

lines.en: : Cause, if that’s the case, Makoto’s the bookiest girl I know and {i}she{/i} doesn’t have a problem sleepin’ with ya. Since when does Maki know more than Makoto about literally anything?
lines.zh: : 因为如果真是这样，Makoto 可是我认识的最照本宣科的女孩，而{i}她{/i}跟你睡可一点意见都没有。Maki 从什么时候起在任何事上都比 Makoto 懂得多了？

lines.en: scene mikusecretapt19
: You know you agree with me, Sensei. That’s why ya keep doin’ the things you’re doin’.
lines.zh: : 你心里知道你同意我，Sensei。所以你才一直做那些事。

lines.en: : That’s precisely {i}not{/i} why I keep doing the things I’m doing, Miku. I do this because I’m addicted, selfish, careless, and self-destructive. It’s the worst combination possible.
lines.zh: : 这恰恰{i}不是{/i}我继续做这些事的原因，Miku。我做这些，是因为我成瘾、自私、粗心又自我毁灭。这是最糟糕的组合了。

lines.en: : But I don’t think I can change at all in a place like this. How {i}could{/i} I when people like you can sit here and try justifying my actions for me when they are specifically designed to be unjustifiable?
lines.zh: : 但我觉得在这样一个地方，我根本改变不了。当你们这样的人坐在这里替我找理由开脱，而这些行为本来就被设计成不可开脱的时候，我又{i}怎么可能{/i}改变呢？

lines.en: : We’re startin’ to get into the “too many big words for Miku” zone but, let me just say this.
lines.zh: : 我们开始进入「对 Miku 来说大词太多」的区域了，不过，我就说一句。

lines.en: : You’re one of the very few things out there I’m not afraid of, Sensei. And that’s gotta count for somethin’.
lines.zh: : 你是这世上我为数不多不害怕的东西之一，Sensei。这总该有点意义吧。

lines.en: scene mikusecretapt20

: So the question {i}now{/i} is what we do about Maki. ‘Cause it ain’t like me and- ahem. It ain’t like Makoto and I are gonna just quit spreadin’ our legs for ya cause it made our mom all sad, you know?
lines.zh: : 所以{i}现在{/i}的问题是我们拿 Maki 怎么办。因为我和——咳。因为我和 Makoto 不会因为妈妈伤心了就不再为你张开腿，你懂吧？

lines.en: : You’ll just let her keep feeling insane on her own, then?
lines.zh: : 那你就让她一个人继续发疯下去？

lines.en: : In a world where everybody’s crazy, it’s the normal person who’s insane, I think. So there ain’t much you can really do but just...wait for ‘em to cave, I guess.
lines.zh: : 在一个所有人都疯了的世界里，发疯的反而是那个正常人，我觉得。所以你也没什么办法，只能……等她们自己撑不住吧，我猜。

lines.en: : I’m sorry. I’m talkin’ too much. All this Maki stuff’s just been really messing with the vibes for Makoto and I. Like, we ain’t sure if we should be {i}doin’{/i} anything or what.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我说太多了。这些 Maki 的事确实很影响我和 Makoto 的心情。比如，我们都不确定自己该{i}做{/i}点什么才好。

lines.en: : Do you really feel safe with me, Miku?
lines.zh: : 你跟我在一起真的有安全感吗，Miku？

lines.en: scene mikusecretapt21
: You really think I’d come all the way over to some secret apartment by myself if I didn’t?
lines.zh: : 要不是这样，你觉得我会一个人大老远跑到什么秘密公寓来吗？

lines.en: : Sensei, if you wanted to hurt me, you’d have done it already.
lines.zh: : Sensei，如果你想伤害我，早就动手了。

lines.en: : Mentally, I mean. Physically, you did kinda destroy my vagina.
lines.zh: : 我是说精神上。身体上，你确实把我的小穴弄坏过。

lines.en: : But hey, {i}somebody{/i} was gonna one day. And I’m glad that person was you — even if your morals and some rulebook would have me think otherwise.
lines.zh: : 不过嘛，{i}总有人{/i}迟早会这么做的。而我很高兴那个人是你——哪怕你的道德感和某本规则手册会让我想法不同。

lines.en: : You and Makoto are both way too good at justifying this. Her, I get. But at least {i}she{/i} had the ethical dilemma of questioning the entire concept of one’s age in an infinite world when-
lines.zh: : 你和 Makoto 都太擅长为此找理由了。她我懂。但至少{i}她{/i}还经历过那种伦理困境——在一个无限的世界里质疑「年龄」这整个概念——当——

lines.en: : And I’m glad that person was you — even if your morals and some rulebook would have me think otherwise.
lines.zh: : 不过嘛，{i}总有人{/i}迟早会这么做的。而我很高兴那个人是你——哪怕你的道德感和某本规则手册会让我想法不同。

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei？

lines.en: scene mikusecretapt22
: Itadakimasu...
lines.zh: : Itadakimasu……

lines.en: scene black
Miku and I eat our “dinner” together and, to my surprise, the taste isn’t all that bad.
lines.zh: Miku 和我一起吃完了我们的「晚餐」，而让我意外的是，味道并没有那么糟。

lines.en: I kind of expected her to forgo seasoning entirely, but...given what she had to work with, I’m definitely impressed.
lines.zh: 我本来还以为她会完全不放调料，但……考虑到她手头能用的东西，我确实挺佩服的。

lines.en: I guess it {i}is{/i} kind of hard to mess up bean sprouts, though. And that there are some things in life that you need to go out of your way to destroy if you really want to complain about them.
lines.zh: 不过豆芽{i}确实{/i}挺难做坏的。而且生活中有些东西，你得特意去把它毁掉，才有资格抱怨。

lines.en: I think I do that a lot. And it makes me thankful to have someone like her here to prove to me just how futile that can be when faced with a foil.
lines.zh: 我觉得我就经常这么干。也因此，我很感激能有像她这样的人在这儿，向我证明，遇到一个对手时，这种做法有多徒劳。

lines.en: I just wish the circumstances were different. But even if they were, I’m sure I’d find something else to taint the flavor of life. Another ethical dilemma to bring up at the dinner table.
lines.zh: 我只是希望境况能有所不同。但就算不同，我肯定也会找到别的东西来败坏生活的滋味。再找一个新的伦理困境，端到餐桌上来谈。

lines.en: And one more thing to ponder while staring at the ceiling in the hours before I manage to fall asleep.
lines.zh: 还有一件事，可以在我终于睡着前的几个小时里，盯着天花板慢慢想。
